_doc: UI text in English, the reference language (UI-014). Grouped by screen and read as dotted keys: t("format.decimal"). Every other language file must have the same keys with the same {placeholders}; tests/locale/ checks this. Data text (names, descriptions) is not here: it sits in each entity's JSON as <field>, with <field>_<lang> beside it.

language._doc: The language's own name, shown on the Options row whatever language is active (locale.name_of).
language.name: English
